name: idle-vivarium-reeds-day-sb
refs: IMAGE 1, THE PICTURE TO EDIT (this room's day, round sa): keep everything but the listed changes:
prompt: Output a NEW image, 16:9: Image 1 edited. KEEP EVERYTHING in Image 1 exactly as it is (the planting, the composition, the palette, the light, the hand-painted miniature finish, the soft back, the camera) and CHANGE ONLY the following. 1. Take out the two low pieces standing on the open floor (the sedge tuft at the left and the rounded stone right of centre) and paint plain open floor where they stood, matching the floor around them. 2. Then add two SMALL low pieces at the very front of the floor, their bases resting on the top edge of the dark soil strip at the bottom: one between about 12 and 30 percent of the width, one between about 68 and 85 percent; each no wider than about 9 percent of the width and no taller than about 8 percent of the height, about the size of a fist beside a pebble; nothing else new on the floor. The two new front pieces: a small sedge tuft (left) and a small wet rounded stone (right). 3. Make the funnel at the right about a third of its size, half hidden among the sedges and in shadow, its single drop kept. 4. Remove the two thin vertical glass posts in the upper back and the half grey cylinder at the far right edge; paint the misty back and sedges there. Do not add anything else; no creatures, no text, no frame, no box, no pool.
